name: Bemco Hydraulics Limited
about: Bemco Hydraulics Limited manufactures and sells hydraulic press machines and related equipment in India and internationally. The company offers C frame/throat type, straightening, steel metal foaming, moulding, baling, and hydraulic wheel fitting presses; hydraulic special purpose machine for metal cutting assembly, such as quenching, multibase cordite extrusion, core driving, and ceramic extrusion presses; and sheet metal forming. It also provides portable, light weight, and hydraulic re-railing equipment, such as power units, control consoles, hand pumps, duo traversing units, roller carriages, distance bars, lifting cylinders, stacking sets, re railing bridges, connecting elements for bridges, high pressure hoses, step jack with claw and accessories, pulling equipment, and tilting jack and accessories. In addition, the company offers wheel press single and double cylinders; wheel skate trolleys; spring scragging and spring preload testing machines; RCC underpass bridge shifting; and customized components, as well as involved in designing, manufacturing, sales, and after sales support for automatic shaft straightening machines. It serves metal working, plastics, wood, rubber, and electronics and electricals industries. The company was formerly known as New BEMCO Engineering Products Ltd. and changed its name to Bemco Hydraulics Limited in December 1976. Bemco Hydraulics Limited was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Belgaum, India.
